title: Colleagues close the door and reveal hidden programs
summary: David Grusch tells of Colleagues close the door and reveal hidden programs, about c. 2019-2021 at Grusch's office, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I had, you know, certain colleagues of mine that I’d known for years approached me, you know, close the door in my office and was like, look, you need to know about some other stuff you guys are not getting access to,

that were placed in my life like 14 years ago, you know shut the door in my office at NGA like, Look dude. And you know, they started telling me all this stuff that I was and they brought these, like, crazy intel reports.
tellings.difference: This telling names NGA as the office and says they brought him "crazy intel reports", and its "14 years ago" points to c. 2009 rather than 2019-2021.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Grusch's firsthand account of colleagues shutting the door in his office and telling him about things he had no access to. This telling places the scene at NGA and mentions intel reports. The "14 years ago" most likely refers to how long he had known the colleagues ("placed in my life"), which matches the story's "colleagues I'd known for years".

as_told.title: People shut the door at NGA and brought Grusch intel reports

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer, says that colleagues he had known for years came into his office, shut the door, and told him there were secret programmes his team was not being given access to. In one telling he says this happened at the NGA, a US spy agency that works with satellite and map intelligence, and that they brought him startling intelligence reports. He tells it as how he first learned of hidden UFO work, though his own dates differ, pointing either to around 2019 to 2021 or to about fourteen years before he spoke.
